name: two-tip
title: Two tip
description: BIOBUZZ 2-tip auto, pollen only: 16 pollen in 4 volleys of 4. Preload into the south cell; sweep the RED garden and score again for tip 1 (8 pollen, team rule); take flower0's 4 and score them in the north cell, which is up after the tip; take flower1's 4 and score again for tip 2; park. Written for RED and mirrored for BLUE (point symmetry).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; half an inch on from the start: a turn on the spot to face the south cell, 55 in away

steps.notes: Turns the 2 degrees to face the south cell from the start.

steps.name: spinUp
steps.notes: Spins the pollen shooter up.
Aim and spin up at the start: the preloads are shot from where the robot starts.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 1: the 4 preloaded pollen into the south cell (4 of the 8 that tip it, team rule).

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; north off the south wall first, to turn clear of it
SET BY HAND: planning choice; round to heading west, well clear of the south wall

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; above the garden lane, heading west

steps.notes: Up and round in one curve, ending heading west above the garden lane.
Slides down onto the lane still facing west, slowly so it stops on time: near the south wall the 22 in body must stay square to it, or its corners swing into the wall.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the sweep.

Slowly west along the garden row, intake toward the red alliance wall, taking the four pollen one after another. The heading is held square to the wall. It always runs to its end, so the robot stops where the path does (a sweep cut short when the robot reads full coasts on toward the wall).
Up to 0.8 s more for the last pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.
Moves up off the lane still facing west (square to the south wall), to where it can turn.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the bearing to the south cell: a turn on the spot to face it, 55 in away

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face the south cell; the garden load is shot from here.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 2 from beside the garden: 4 garden pollen, the south cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS (tip 1).

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; heads north-east then north, the way the robot already faces after the volley
SET BY HAND: planning choice; onto flower0's centre line as far east as the hive frame's west bar allows (the robot, heading west at y = -24, clears it while x <= -32.6), for a longer straight run-in

steps.notes: One curve from the garden volley to flower0, ending heading west (no turn first).

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower0's opening.

Slowly nose-in to flower0 holding the heading square to the wall (a tangent heading would turn a small sideways offset into a yaw that swings the mouth off the opening): the flower bar at its retrieval opening, the intake pulls its 4 pollen.
Waits for the 4th pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up before backing off.
Backs straight off flower0, still facing it.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face north

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face north.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; straight north, well west of the hive frame's west foot bar and legs
SET BY HAND: planning choice; 10 in back along the north-cell bearing, so the robot arrives facing the north cell

steps.notes: Nose-first round the WEST side of the hive frame to the spot north of the hive, arriving facing the north cell (up after tip 1).

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 3: 4 flower pollen into the north cell (4 of 8).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north: a turn on the spot to face flower1

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face flower1, straight north.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: Starts the intake before the slow approach.

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower1's opening.
Slowly nose-in to flower1's retrieval opening, heading held square to the wall.
Waits for the 4th pollen.

steps.name: intakeOff
steps.notes: Stops the intake.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up before backing off.

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in north of the score spot, where the turn back starts

steps.notes: Backs straight off flower1, still facing it.
Turns on the spot (over the last inch) to face the north cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 4: the north cell reaches 8 and the hive TIPS again (tip 2).

to.provenance: SET BY HAND: planning choice; 1 in along the next leg's start: a turn on the spot toward the park spot

steps.notes: Turns on the spot to face along the leg to the park spot.
Nose-first to the park spot, partly in RED's loading zone.
